AIInsights.description: The AI's resume review (generated with the visitor's own key, cached on the resume).
AIInsights.title: AIInsights

AIKeyCheckIn.description: A visitor's provider + key to verify. The key is used once and never stored.
AIKeyCheckIn.title: AIKeyCheckIn

AIKeyCheckOut.description: The chat models this key can use, plus the one we suggest pre-selecting.
AIKeyCheckOut.title: AIKeyCheckOut

ApplicationEventOut.description: A single entry in a saved posting's status-change history.
ApplicationEventOut.title: ApplicationEventOut

ApplicationStatus.description:
Seven stages of a co-op application lifecycle.
str mixin lets FastAPI serialise these as plain strings automatically.
NULL in the database means "no status set" — distinct from any value here.
ApplicationStatus.title: ApplicationStatus

AskRequest.description:
mode "question": answer `question` with citations (question required)
mode "tailor":   how to tailor this resume for the posting (question optional)
mode "cover_letter": a short cover-letter opening for the posting (question optional)
AskRequest.title: AskRequest

CategoryCount.description: A job type for the filter list, with how many open postings it has.
CategoryCount.title: CategoryCount

ChangePasswordIn.description: Password change payload — new password must meet the same rules as registration.
ChangePasswordIn.title: ChangePasswordIn

DeleteAccountIn.description: Account deletion — requires password confirmation to prevent accidental deletion.
DeleteAccountIn.title: DeleteAccountIn

DemandSkill.description: A skill employers ask for, and how many open postings ask for it.
DemandSkill.title: DemandSkill

DetectedEducation.description: What was read from the resume's education section (blank when not found).
DetectedEducation.title: DetectedEducation

EventCreateIn.description: Body for POST /api/saved/{id}/events — record a status change with optional note.
EventCreateIn.title: EventCreateIn

FilterMeta.description:
Distinct values available for each filter dropdown.
Populated from the postings table so the frontend never shows a city
that has zero postings.
FilterMeta.title: FilterMeta

JobPreferences.description:
What the student is looking for, set before or after uploading. Matching only considers
open postings that fit these; keywords (e.g. "data analyst") rank fitting postings higher.
JobPreferences.title: JobPreferences

LoginIn.description: Login payload — password has no min length here (wrong pw → 401, not 422).
LoginIn.title: LoginIn

ManualPostingIn.description: Schema for manually submitted postings via POST /api/postings.
ManualPostingIn.title: ManualPostingIn

PostingDetail.description: Full posting detail — includes description for the detail page.
PostingDetail.title: PostingDetail

PostingListItem.description:
One row in the postings table.
Omits description to keep list payloads small (see contracts/api.md note).
PostingListItem.title: PostingListItem

PublicConfig.description: What the UI should show. Never includes secrets — only which features are on.
PublicConfig.title: PublicConfig

RegisterIn.description: Registration payload — email must be valid format, password ≥ 10 chars.
RegisterIn.title: RegisterIn

ResumeInsights.description: Free insights (always present) plus the AI review (None until requested).
ResumeInsights.title: ResumeInsights

RowError.description: A single per-row validation error from a CSV upload.
RowError.title: RowError

SaveIn.description: Body for POST /api/saved — just the posting ID to bookmark.
SaveIn.title: SaveIn

SavedPostingOut.description:
A saved posting record with the full posting embedded.
Returned by GET /api/saved items and POST/PATCH operations.
SavedPostingOut.title: SavedPostingOut

SavedPostingsPage.description: Paginated list of saved postings with per-status counts.
SavedPostingsPage.title: SavedPostingsPage

SimilarPostingOut.description: One item in the similar postings response.
SimilarPostingOut.title: SimilarPostingOut

SourcePatchIn.description: Fields that can be patched on an IngestSource (all optional).
SourcePatchIn.title: SourcePatchIn

StatusUpdateIn.description: Body for PATCH /api/saved/{id}/status — pass null to clear the status.
StatusUpdateIn.title: StatusUpdateIn

UserOut.description: Public user representation — never includes hashed_password.
UserOut.title: UserOut

WorkMode.description:
Stored as a PostgreSQL ENUM type (work_mode_enum) so the DB enforces
valid values without needing an application-layer check.
str mixin means FastAPI can serialise it as a plain string.
WorkMode.title: WorkMode

info.description: Co-op posting aggregator — browse, search, save, track, and match your resume.
info.title: CoopRadar API

get.description: List all ingest sources with their latest run stats.

schema.title: Response Get Sources Api Admin Sources Get

patch.description: Enable, disable, or un-pause a source.

post.description: Trigger an immediate run for a source (409 if one is already running).

get.description: Paginated run history for a source.

post.description: Verify the key with its provider. 400 AI_KEY_INVALID if rejected; 429 when over the limit.

"Try the demo": create a private, pre-filled demo account and log into it.
Returns 404 DEMO_DISABLED when DEMO_ENABLED=false; 429 after 10 per IP per hour.

Start using CoopRadar without signing up: an empty temporary account (kept 7 days).
Save it permanently later with POST /api/me/claim.

Authenticate and start a session.
Returns 401 with the same message for unknown email or wrong password (FR-014).
Invalidate the session immediately and clear the browser cookie.

Create a new account and start a session.
Returns 409 if the email is already registered.

get.description: Feature flags for the UI. Never includes secrets — only whether features are on.
Liveness probe used by the host and CI — no database calls.

delete.description:
Permanently delete the account and all associated data (saved postings, statuses).
CASCADE delete in the DB handles the cascade.  Returns 401 if password is wrong.

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user's profile.

post.description:
Keep a temporary (guest/demo) account: add an email + password. All saved jobs, the resume,
and matches stay. 400 ALREADY_CLAIMED for normal accounts, 409 EMAIL_TAKEN if in use.

patch.description:
Change the user's password.
Returns 401 if current_password is wrong, 422 if new_password < 10 chars.

get.description:
List postings with optional keyword/semantic search, filters, sort, and pagination.
FastAPI validates every query param against PostingListParams, so an unknown
sort column or page size is a 422 before the service runs.
Authenticated users also get is_saved on each item.

post.description: Add a single posting manually. Returns 409 if a duplicate already exists.

get.description:
Return distinct values for filter dropdowns (cities, provinces, terms, skills).
Cached by the frontend for 5 minutes — values change only when new postings arrive.

post.description:
Bulk-import postings from a CSV file.
Rate-limited to 3 uploads per user per hour.

get.description: Full detail for a single posting. Returns 404 if the ID doesn't exist.
Return up to 5 postings most similar by embedding cosine similarity.

delete.description: Permanently delete the resume and all match results.

get.description: Return stored resume metadata for the authenticated user.

post.description:
Upload a resume (PDF/DOCX, ≤5 MB), extract text, run match pipeline,
store results, and return ranked matches. With the visitor's AI key (X-AI-* headers) the
AI ranks and explains matches; without any key, matches are ranked by skill overlap for
free. Only the site owner's fallback key counts toward the daily AI limit.
`preferences` (optional) is a JobPreferences JSON object: what the student is looking for.

get.description: Skills found + in-demand skills you're missing (free), plus the cached AI review if any.

post.description: Run the AI resume review on the visitor's key (strengths, tips, roles) and cache it.

get.description: Return stored ranked match results. Empty list if no resume on file.

post.description:
Stream a cited Q&A response about a matched posting.
Response is text/event-stream with delta chunks ending in [DONE].
Re-rank the stored resume against today's postings with the visitor's AI.

get.description:
Return the current user's saved postings with status counts, deadlines, and stats.
Optionally filter by status.  Ordered by most recently saved.

post.description:
Bookmark a posting.  Idempotent — returns 201 on first save, 200 if already saved.
Returns 404 if the posting_id doesn't exist.

get.description:
Download the current user's full tracker as a CSV file.
Generated server-side with pandas; streamed directly to the browser.

delete.description: Remove a saved posting. Returns 404 if not found or owned by another user.

post.description:
Manually add a status event (e.g. note an interview date retroactively).
Also updates the current status on the saved posting.

patch.description:
Update the application status on a saved posting and record the change as an event.
Pass null status to clear. Returns 404 if not found or owned by another user.
